As time went by, I wrote a poem to record this.

title.en: When I first arrived at Junzhou, I planted four clumps of bamboo and two fir trees in the courtyard of the liquor bureau. Now three years have passed, and both have flourished. title.zh_modern: 去年冬天，蘇轍以起居郎的身份入宮侍奉邇英閣的講讀，不久後升任中書舍人。雖然深感慚愧，但瞻望聖上容光，與日俱遠。追憶當時所見，寫下四首絕句，呈給同省諸公。

title.en: Last winter, I, Zhe, served in the Qiyi Pavilion as a Qiju Lang, and soon after was promoted to Zhongshu Sheren. Though I felt deeply unworthy, the distance from the imperial radiance grew daily. Recalling what I saw then, I wrote four quatrains to present to my colleagues in the same department.
